title: Super Cup ATTP – Winter 2024: OPEN
excerpt: Results of the second stage of the ATTP Super Cup – Winter 2024
body_html:
One of the most ambitious table tennis tournaments under the auspices of ATTP — the WINTER 2024 season of the SUPER CUP series — has come to an end, and as organiser it was a great honour for ATTP to welcome more than 230 guests over these two days.

Thank you to everyone involved in this large and important table tennis event in our country. Table tennis in Moldova has never before had such scale and such an audience. We can now say with certainty that the tournament met and exceeded all the organisers’ expectations.

With the arrival of the SUPER CUP ATTP series, for the first time in history everyone saw competitions whose main values were the sport and the people who play it, not the narrow interests of certain individuals. This gave hope to dozens, if not hundreds, of table tennis amateurs of different ages, professions and playing experience who dreamed of one day stepping onto the podium of a national tournament.

In particular, the ATTP leadership addressed all players and table tennis fans to tell them that “they are loved, deeply respected and valued, that we all believe in them, and to assure them that ATTP and its partners will not miss the chance to do everything necessary so that our wins and yours bring us joy for many years to come”.
